about_the_game:
"This is the start of a saga for the ages!"

- Logan Grimnar

Become the hunter by collecting the Space Wolves! Leman Russ’ legacy continues in Warhammer 40,000: Warpforge with his sons joining the game as a new collectable faction, ready to make their howl be heard across the stars. Sharpen your senses and pursue your prey to the edge of the Galaxy by commanding one of the most ferocious factions to join the battlefield yet!

Get the best start with this bundle, which includes:

A new Legendary Warlord: Logan Grimnar

10 Space Wolves booster packs: each contains 5 cards from this new faction, with a guaranteed rare or better card in each booster pack

An exclusive Cosmetic Item: 'Logan Grimnar’ avatar

This DLC offers the best way to kick-start your Space Wolves collection. Are you ready to begin your saga?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains content not appropriate for all ages, including infrequent strong language, depictions of violence and gore, and online interaction between players.
